Those Cold Mists are using droplets of water to refract the light and make themselves nearly invisible!|audio = FrostWave12-1.ogg|[[Professor V]] on Wave 10 ([[Frost Mode|Frost]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Cold Mist''' is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. As it is a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, it can only be targeted by towers with hidden detection. It has slightly fast speed, being slower than the [[Frostmite]], but faster than the [[Packed Ice]]. It also has quite high health. ==Logbook Description== "''Cold Mists haunt battlefields within the Frost Realm, feeding off fallen creatures' energy as they drift through the air on wisps of snow. Though they can phase through any being, although, living creatures touched by a Cold Mist will freeze from the inside out. Composed of extremely cold moisture, they appear almost invisible.''" ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Cold Mist''' is a humanoid figure composed of dark blue cold moisture, which gives it its translucent body. It floats above the ground, having a wispy tail instead of legs. It has various spikes coming out of its body and two scars on its face. It also wears a chain around its neck. |Version 1 |The '''Cold Mist''' was a humanoid figure composed of dark blue cold moisture, which gave it its translucent body. It floated above the ground, having a wispy tail instead of legs, with its head pointed down toward the ground. It was meant to wear a translucent dark blue chain with a lock, though it did not appear on its body. }} ==Strategy== *Early-game towers with hidden detection, like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Archer]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Cowboy]] are recommended against this. **As it generally spawns in groups, towers like the [[Rocketeer]] can be used to kill multiple of them at once. **The [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give towers hidden detection. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} ColdMistOperationICE.png|First version (16 December 2024 – 3 December 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1ColdMist.png|Green variant, first version (11 June 2025 – 3 December 2025) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseOIColdMist.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, first version (12 March 2025 – 3 December 2025) CorpseColdMist25.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, second version (3 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Valentines Crate 2026 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Cold Mist''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ColdMistIconIG.png|'''Cold Mist''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Cold Mist''' was meant to wear a blue chain with a lock around its neck, just like its version from [[Krampus' Revenge Event]], though it does not appear. **This can still be seen on its icon in the [[Index]]. *The '''Cold Mist''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
